title: harbor registry with seaweed-s3 has error
body:
**Describe the bug**
# issue desc
## harbor registry use s3 storage
```yaml
storage:
      s3:
        region: us-west-1 
        bucket: harbor
        accesskey: harborAccessKey9k2
        secretkey: harborSecretKey9Mn
        regionendpoint: http://10.111.32.55:8333
        #keyid: harbor
        secure: false
        v4auth: false
        chunksize: 5242880
        rootdirectory: /
```


## `seaweed-s3 -config` file 
```json
{
  "identities": [
    {
      "name": "admin",
      "credentials": [
        {
          "accessKey": "adminAccessKey73h",
          "secretKey": "adminSecretKey98n"
        }
      ],
      "actions": [
        "Admin",
        "Read",
        "Write"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "harbor",
      "credentials": [
        {
          "accessKey": "harborAccessKey9k2",
          "secretKey": "harborSecretKey9Mn"
        }
      ],
      "actions": [
        "Read:harbor",
        "Write:harbor"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```




**System Setup**
- List the command line to start "weed master", "weed volume", "weed filer", "weed s3", "weed mount".
```bash
# weed-volume
/data/apps/opt/seaweed/weed volume -dataCenter dc1 -rack rack1 -dir /data/apps/data/seaweed-volume -ip 10.111.32.55 -port 9222 -ip.bind 10.111.32.55 -max 20 -mserver 10.111.32.55:9333,10.111.32.58:9333,10.111.32.61:9333 -publicUrl 10.111.32.55:9222
# weed-master
/data/apps/opt/seaweed/weed master -ip=10.111.32.55 -port=9333 -mdir=/data/apps/data/seaweed-master -peers=10.111.32.55:9333,10.111.32.58:9333,10.111.32.61:9333 -defaultReplication=002 -metrics.address=10.111.32.178/pushgateway/
# weed-filer
/data/apps/opt/seaweed/weed -logdir /data/apps/log/seaweed-filer filer -master=10.111.32.55:9333,10.111.32.58:9333,10.111.32.61:9333 -ip=10.111.32.55 -port=8888 -defaultReplicaPlacement=002 -dataCenter=dc1

# weed-s3
/data/apps/opt/seaweed/weed -logdir /data/apps/log/seaweed-s3 s3 -filer=10.111.32.55:8888 -port=8333 -config=s3-config.json


```
- OS version: centos-7.4
- output of `weed version`: seaweed-1.74_large_disk
- if using filer, show the content of `filer.toml`
```toml

]

# automatically use the closest Redis server for reads
```
